messages:
dan.support: Heads up 0: SprocketCo (trial) ingest is spiking since ~09:00 UTC. We've seen 429s and a couple of timeouts. Theyre doing large embedding uploads. Support put a soft rate limit to protect cluster and are escalating to CS for comms & renewal risk.

maria.csm: Thanks. Do we know if this is quota exhaustion vs abusive parallel uploads? Need a quick template to reassure them. I'll offer an enablement call + temporary bump.

ops-bot: alert: rate_limit_policy_triggered customer_id=sprocket-42 policy=ingest-default window=60s spikes=3

alex.eng: From ingest-v2 logs: parallel uploads causing KV cache churn -> 429s. Not a backend outage. We can approve +25% quota for 2 hours if infra OK. Also recommend batching docs. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/ingest-throttle

jamie.csops: Drafting comms. Short, empathetic, actionable. Suggest include: why (onboarding burst), what we did (temporary protection), options: 1) 30m enablement to walk batching, 2) +25% quota for 2h, 3) share best-practice snippet. Include a one-click Calendly.

maria.csm: Draft reply: "Hi Sprocket team Thanks for the heads-up. Weve applied a temporary protection to keep your trial stable. Would you like (A) a 30m enablement to optimize batching, or (B) a short +25% quota bump while you run the backfill? Reply A or B and well take action. Maria"

dan.support: Customer says they kicked off a backfill script this morning that forks a curl per file. Sent snippet.

alex.eng: That pattern is hammering. Share this recommended pattern: ```xargs -P 4 -I{} curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -d @{} < <(printf "%s\n" files/*)``` and recommend batching 25-50 docs per request.

jamie.csops: Pasting email template into thread: "Hi Sprocketteam \n\nWe noticed a high ingestion rate from your trial account. To keep things stable we applied temporary protection. Two quick options: (1) 30m enablement call to optimize batching and throughput, or (2) +25% quota for 2 hours while you run the backfill with batching. Reply \"BUMP\" to request option (2) and well provision now. If you pick (1) share a few times. Also attaching a short batching guide and a sample script. \n\nThanks,\nMaria (CSM)"

ops-bot: infra-request-created id=ir-87345 type=quota-bump requester=maria.csm amount=25% duration=2h status=pending

alex.eng: I'll watch metrics and stand by to tweak ingest config. I put a 3-hour watch on the ingest cluster with an alert to paging if errors > 5% baseline.

maria.csm: Action list: jamie finalize email and send:done, ops approve bump:pending, dan ask customer to choose: in progress, alex monitor: watching.

dan.support: Pinged customer asking A or B. ETA reply ~20-30m.

jamie.csops: Adding follow-up questions for feedback capture: did onboarding docs cover parallel upload pitfalls? How did they discover the backfill? We'll add notes to onboarding checklist.

maria.csm: Marking P1 for CS. If no reply in 45m I'll escalate to AM. Will update thread when customer responds. :eyes:
